title: Mean value problem for polynomial critical points
exact_target: For any complex polynomial and any noncritical point, is there a critical point whose secant slope in absolute value is at most the derivative at the given point?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2400007 (AMR-023-0007). CC BY 4.0.
Edward Crane, Mean Value Conjectures for Rational Maps (2004), arXiv:math/0411604, Section 1, p. 1, Smale theorem and equation (1).
